name: Bronte Callaghan
bio:
Bronte's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for V8 Supercars, fueled by her father's weekend trips to Bathurst. She excelled in mechanical engineering at university, securing an internship with a local racing team before moving to Europe to pursue her Formula 1 dream. After several years honing her skills at smaller teams, she joined Mercedes-AMG. 

As a performance engineer, Bronte thrives on data analysis and problem-solving. She's known for her meticulous approach to optimizing car setup and extracting every last bit of performance. Her ability to quickly adapt to changing conditions and communicate complex technical information to the drivers makes her a valuable asset to the team. Bronte is driven by a relentless pursuit of perfection and a deep understanding of vehicle dynamics. 

Bronte distinguishes herself through her proactive approach and her ability to anticipate potential issues before they arise. Her colleagues often remark on her ability to see the bigger picture and her dedication to continuous improvement. She is a valued team member, known for her collaborative spirit and commitment to excellence.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair, usually tied back in a practical ponytail during race weekends
physical.description: Bronte is of average height with a lean, athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Australian tea before every race.
